info.title: Twitch Universal API
info.description: Manage channels, schedules, polls, clips, and stream settings

post.description: Creates a stream schedule segment in Twitch.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

broadcasterId.description: The broadcaster whose schedule to update. This ID must match the user ID in the access token.

startTime.description: RFC3339 timestamp for the scheduled segment, for example 2026-03-13T18:30:00Z.

timezone.description: IANA time zone where the broadcast takes place.

duration.description: Scheduled length in minutes. Twitch requires a value from 30 through 1380.

categoryId.description: Category/game ID that best represents the broadcast content.

post.description: Creates a new clip in Twitch.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

broadcasterId.description: The broadcaster whose live stream to clip.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds. Possible values range from 5 to 60 with 0.1 precision. Default is 30.

editUrl.description: URL used to edit and publish the clip.

data.description: A list containing the created clip.

post.description: Creates a custom reward in Twitch.

isMaxPerUserPerStreamEnabled.description: Whether to limit the maximum number of redemptions allowed per user per live stream.

maxPerUserPerStream.description: The maximum number of redemptions allowed per user per live stream.

isGlobalCooldownEnabled.description: Whether to apply a cooldown period between redemptions.

shouldRedemptionsSkipRequestQueue.description: Whether redemptions should be fulfilled immediately when redeemed.

cooldownExpiresAt.description: Cooldown expiry timestamp when the reward is cooling down.

cost.description: Reward redemption cost in channel points.

isEnabled.description: Whether the global cooldown is enabled.

isInStock.description: Whether the reward is in stock.

isUserInputRequired.description: Whether the reward requires viewer input.

isEnabled.description: Whether the per-stream limit is enabled.
Whether the per-user per-stream limit is enabled.

prompt.description: Prompt shown when user input is required.

put.description: Updates a stream schedule segment in Twitch.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

broadcasterId.description: The ID of the broadcaster who owns the broadcast segment.

id.description: The ID of the broadcast segment to update.

startTime.description: The date and time that the broadcast segment starts in RFC3339 format.

duration.description: The length of time, in minutes, that the broadcast is scheduled to run.

categoryId.description: The ID of the category that best represents the broadcast’s content.

isCanceled.description: Whether to cancel the scheduled segment.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone where the broadcast takes place.

put.description: Updates channel chat settings in Twitch.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

broadcasterId.description: The ID of the broadcaster whose chat settings you want to update.

moderatorId.description: The ID of the moderator making the update.

emoteMode.description: Whether chat messages must contain only emotes.

followerMode.description: Whether the broadcaster restricts the chat room to followers only.

followerModeDuration.description: How long, in minutes, users must follow before chatting.

nonModeratorChatDelay.description: Whether to delay non-moderator messages before showing them in chat.

nonModeratorChatDelayDuration.description: The number of seconds to delay non-moderator chat messages.

slowMode.description: Whether to limit how often users may send messages.

slowModeWaitTime.description: The number of seconds users must wait between messages.

uniqueChatMode.description: Whether only unique chat messages are allowed.
